gloss: intensity of rain; rain sweeping past

definitions.gloss: intensity of rain; rain sweeping past
definitions.explanation: How hard the rain is falling, or the rain seen moving across an area in streaks.

examples.japanese: {雨脚|あまあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}まった→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧。
⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{雨脚|あまあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}まって→弱まる：02330_yowamaru⟧きた。
examples.english: The rain began to ease off in the evening.

examples.japanese: {雨脚|あまあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I hurried out of the station, hoping to get home before the rain came down harder.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨脚|あまあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}まる→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧ / ⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the rain gets heavier
- {雨脚|あまあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}まる→弱まる：02330_yowamaru⟧: the rain eases
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{雨脚|あまあし}: driving rain

WRITING:
Also written {雨足|あまあし}, and also read あめあし. Common in weather reports.
